locus: Dominica in Palmis, printed p.134 / original PDF p.220, right column: complete Benedic prayer with actual Per Dominum. ending.
rights_basis: The Pustet Ratisbon printing was published in 1862 and is in the United States public domain by publication date. Faithful mechanical page extraction and a checked transcription add no new prayer wording. This basis does not clear any later target contribution.
text: Benedic, quaesumus Domine, hos palmarum seu olivarum ramos: et praesta; ut, quod populus tuus in tui venerationem hodierna die corporaliter agit, hoc spiritualiter summa devotione perficiat, de hoste victoriam reportando, et opus misericordiae summopere diligendo. Per Dominum.
